title: Yakisoba
intro: Yakisoba is a Japanese stir-fried noodle dish cooked at festival stalls and family kitchens alike, known for its distinctive dark, tangy-sweet sauce rather than the soy-based sauces common to other noodle stir-fries. The combination of charred vegetables and glossy, well-coated noodles is what makes it such a popular quick meal.
